points.K14: 门口有危害与禁入标识
points.K15: 病原被关在各自工作区
points.S1: 进三级室，先批准再准入
points.S2: 高致病性，在相应级别室
points.S4: 更衣淋浴，洁到污不逆行

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一扇封闭实验室的门前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a sealed laboratory door.
shots.narration: 今天带你看，三级室怎么封住病原。

shots.scene: 欣欣指向门上的生物危害标志
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a biohazard sign on the door.
shots.narration: 靠的不是锁，是气流。

shots.scene: 阿杰隔着玻璃好奇地往里看
shots.prompt_en: The young male student peers curiously through a glass window.
shots.narration: 阿杰问：空气不会把病原带出来吗？

shots.scene: 老李穿着设施工服指着通风口
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in work clothes points at an air vent.
shots.narration: 老李说：看气往哪个方向走。

shots.scene: 一条蓝色气流箭头把病原图标往里压
shots.prompt_en: A blue airflow arrow pushes a pathogen icon inward. No people.
shots.narration: 定向气流，把病原控在屋里。

shots.scene: 一间屋子被一圈气流包住
shots.prompt_en: A room wrapped in a ring of airflow. No people.
shots.narration: 这就是封闭的基本思路。

shots.scene: 一间气闸间，两侧箭头向外推
shots.prompt_en: An airlock room with arrows pushing outward on both sides. No people.
shots.narration: 气闸间是正压，把空气挡在外。

shots.scene: 一道向下的风幕像超市门口
shots.prompt_en: A downward air curtain like a supermarket entrance. No people.
shots.narration: 正压像一道风幕，往下压。

shots.scene: 风幕把病原图标压在门内一侧
shots.prompt_en: The air curtain keeps a pathogen icon on the inner side of the door. No people.
shots.narration: 病原就被锁在封闭区里。

shots.scene: 里面一区，箭头全部向内
shots.prompt_en: An inner zone with all arrows pointing inward. No people.
shots.narration: 再往里是负压，空气只进不出。

shots.scene: 排风口前装一层高效过滤网
shots.prompt_en: An exhaust vent fitted with a high-efficiency filter. No people.
shots.narration: 排风先过高效过滤，再出门。

shots.scene: 过滤网把病原颗粒拦在网里
shots.prompt_en: The filter traps pathogen particles in its mesh. No people.
shots.narration: 过滤器把病原截在滤材里。

shots.scene: 气流沿墙升到天花板的过滤器
shots.prompt_en: Airflow rises along the wall to a ceiling filter. No people.
shots.narration: 气流被导到顶部，过滤后排出。

shots.scene: 一个齿轮图标压在气流箭头上
shots.prompt_en: A gear icon over an airflow arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 定向气流，是一种工程控制。

shots.scene: 多间实验室都画着同样的气流
shots.prompt_en: Several labs all drawn with the same airflow pattern. No people.
shots.narration: 各类生物实验室都用它。

shots.scene: 一排套间，负压数字一间比一间低
shots.prompt_en: A row of suites with pressure getting more negative inward. No people.
shots.narration: 越往里走，负压越低。

shots.scene: 负压套间里放着诊断和实验图标
shots.prompt_en: A negative-pressure suite holding diagnostic and experiment icons. No people.
shots.narration: 涉病原的活，都在负压间做。

shots.scene: 一张平面图，洁净区绿、污染区红
shots.prompt_en: A floor plan: clean zone in green, dirty zone in red. No people.
shots.narration: 平面分区：洁净和污染分开。

shots.scene: 一扇更衣间门，挂着工服图标
shots.prompt_en: A change-room door with a gown icon. No people.
shots.narration: 进出要走更衣流程。

shots.section_title: 门口有危害与禁入标识
shots.scene: 门口贴着生物危害标志和禁入标志
shots.prompt_en: A biohazard sign and a no-entry sign at the door. No people.
shots.narration: 门口有危害和禁止擅入标识。
overlay: 门口有危害与禁入标识

shots.section_title: 病原被关在各自工作区
shots.scene: 病原图标被圈在各自的工作区里
shots.prompt_en: Pathogen icons enclosed within their own work zones. No people.
shots.narration: 病原被关在各自的工作区。
overlay: 病原被关在各自工作区

shots.section_title: 进三级室，先批准再准入
shots.scene: 王老师在门口核对批准单和培训记录
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks an approval form and training record at the door.
shots.narration: 进三级室，先批准、先培训。
overlay: 进三级室，先批准再准入

shots.section_title: 进三级室，先批准再准入
shots.scene: 阿杰出示门禁卡，被引导进入
shots.prompt_en: The young male student shows an access card and is guided in.
shots.narration: 没准入，不能单独进。

shots.section_title: 高致病性，在相应级别室
shots.scene: 一份高致病性实验的审批单盖章
shots.prompt_en: An approval form for high-consequence work being stamped. No people.
shots.narration: 高致病性，须在相应级别室做。
overlay: 高致病性，在相应级别室

shots.scene: 门口压差表报警，小研停下操作
shots.prompt_en: A pressure gauge at the door shows an alarm; the female graduate student stops work.
shots.narration: 气流或停电异常，先停手。

shots.scene: 墙上应急预案牌被点亮
shots.prompt_en: An emergency-plan board on the wall lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 按预案报告、撤离、处置。

shots.section_title: 更衣淋浴，洁到污不逆行
shots.scene: 更衣淋浴流程：洁净→污染单向箭头
shots.prompt_en: A change-and-shower flow with a one-way clean-to-dirty arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 更衣淋浴，洁到污，不走回头。
overlay: 更衣淋浴，洁到污不逆行

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁：正压风幕、负压箭头、顶部过滤
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot beside an air curtain, inward arrows and a ceiling filter.
shots.narration: 正压挡、负压收、过滤排。

shots.scene: 批准单、级别标尺、更衣流程三图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: an approval form, a level scale, a change-room flow. No people.
shots.narration: 先批准、按级别、守流程。

shots.scene: 欣欣在门前挥手，气流箭头环绕
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves in front of the door with airflow arrows around.
shots.narration: 气流守得住，我们下次见！
